'''''Hydian Marauder''''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] vessel that crashed near the [[Sluuce Canyon/Legends|Sluuce Canyon]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], between [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] and [[Arnthout/Legends|Arnthout]].
